title: Wildlife and Fisheries Science, B.S. — Wildlife Option (College of Agricultural Sciences)
notes: Wildlife Option, University Park (of two: Wildlife, Fisheries -- Wildlife chosen for fewer new small-department dependencies). The entire WFS department catalog and FOR 203/350 (Forest Ecosystems dept, real anchor courses, not generic pools) were missing entirely -- added minimal entries in new wfs_catalog.json/for_catalog.json sourced from PSU course description pages. 'Genetics' pool (BIOL 133/222/230W/ANSC 322) resolved to BIOL 133 (no prereq, simplest path). WFS 407/WFS 406 (Ornithology + lab) are taken together in Semester 6; WFS 408 (Mammalogy, lecture only) covers the bulletin's second 'WFS 407 or 408' selection in Semester 8, avoiding scheduling the same course code twice. 'First-Year Seminar' pool is modeled generically, same convention as CMPSC's own open pools. Post-rescrape real gaps found: (1) The prior note here claimed STAT 240's 'MATH 21' prereq was an uncompletable placement gate patched into stat_catalog.json with MATH 110/140 alternates -- after the fresh re-scrape (catalogs no longer hand-patched), it's a real, literal, single-option MATH 21 prereq. CHEM 110 also has a real, literal 'MATH 22' prereq, needed for BIOL 240W (no alternative) and CHEM 202. Added the shared MATH 3 -> MATH 4 -> MATH 21 chain, then MATH 21 -> MATH 22 -> CHEM 110 and MATH 21 -> STAT 240 branches, across Semesters 1-4; this alone clears CHEM 110/111/202/BIOL 240W/FOR 350. Also dropped the 'or STAT 301' fallback from the STAT 240 item: STAT 301 does not exist in any catalog file, so it was being picked ahead of STAT 240 the moment it was tried (no prereq gate at all) purely because it isn't cataloged -- which silently broke FOR 350/WFS 446's real STAT 240 requirement instead of satisfying it. Trimmed two generic 'Elective' filler slots (Semesters 5/8) to keep real credit growth from pushing past 8 terms. (2) CORRECTED -- the prior note here wrongly flagged WFS 301/310/446's WILDL 101 reference as an uncompletable gap needing a new catalog entry. Verified directly against the real Ecosystem Science and Management department handbook (ecosystems.psu.edu/undergraduate/resources/handbooks/wildlife-and-fisheries-science-student-handbook) and the live WFS course descriptions: WILDL 101 ('Introduction to Wildlife Management', 3cr, no prereqs -- a real, currently-catalogued PSU course, confirmed at bulletins.psu.edu/university-course-descriptions/undergraduate/wildl/) is one branch of an OR against WFS 209 in all three courses' real concurrent/prereq text (e.g. WFS 301: 'BIOL 110 and (WFS 209 or WILDL 101)'), not a mandatory standalone AND requirement -- and wfs_catalog.json's existing concurrent_groups for these three courses already encode it correctly as an OR-group (['WFS 209N', 'WILDL 101']), which concurrent_satisfied() treats as satisfied by either alternative. Since WFS 209N is already required in Semester 2, this was never actually a scheduling blocker; confirmed via build_full_plan (no 'Could not schedule' warnings for these three courses). The department's own real, published enumerated lists were also found for three previously-generic pools and wired via the engine's 'match' field (crediting a student's already-completed course and boosting its recommendation score, same treatment as CMPSC's curated technical-elective category -- these lists span departments not all loaded in this plan, so they don't feed the active semester-by-semester auto-fill): 'Natural Resource Policy/Planning/Law/Admin/Human Dimensions' (BLAW/RM 425, ERM 411, FOR 410/450W/480, GEOG 1N/30N/430/431/438W, RPTM 120/320, SOILS 71/422, WFS 430/461), 'Botany Selection' (BIOL 127/414/441, FOR 308/303/403, HORT 101/138/445), and 'Fisheries Selection' for the Wildlife option (WFS 410/422/452/453/463W).
